description:
List documented pages, optionally inside one space.

        Use when the caller wants an inventory ("what manuals exist for ranger")
        rather than an answer.

        Args:
            space: optional space slug or name fragment.
            limit: 1-300, default 100.
            offset: pagination offset, must be >= 0.

        Returns JSON: {space, count, offset, docs:[{doc_id,title,space,url,chars}]}.
        ``count`` is the number of docs in this page; compare it with ``limit`` to
        decide whether to request the next page. There is no total field — use
        ``list_spaces`` for per-space counts.
name: list_docs
